component.name: Tachyon
component.summary: Ultra-fast, lightweight music player with continuous crossfade and DSP effects

description.p: Tachyon is an ultra-fast, modern, and lightweight open-source music player designed for audiophiles and power users who demand high audio fidelity, fluid performance, and an elegant Material 3 interface.

Engineered with a clean, decoupled architecture between the visual UI and the background audio service isolate, Tachyon delivers zero UI jank, instant O(1) library navigation via an in-memory relational graph, and industry-leading resource efficiency. In minimized mode, it automatically suspends heavy rendering, purges graphics memory, and throttles background timers to maintain minimal CPU and RAM usage.

ul.li: Custom-built high-fidelity audio engine (miniaudio_player) with seamless continuous 25ms crossfade (Equal-Power and Linear curves) and gapless playback.

Studio-grade DSP audio suite: 10-band equalizer, Bauer Crossfeed (bs2b) for fatigue-free headphone listening, stereo widener, Freeverb algorithmic reverb, true-peak limiter, pitch shifting, and playback speed control (0.5x–1.5x).
Hierarchical synchronized lyrics with real-time O(log n) scrolling, tap-to-seek, multi-source fallback (embedded USLT, local .lrc files, LRCLIB, and lyrics.ovh), and automated translation.
Pure Dart isolate metadata extraction and smart album art cache without external CLI binaries or FFmpeg dependencies.
Adaptive Material 3 UI with dynamic color scheme, pure OLED black mode, and complete multi-language support (i18n).
100% offline-first and privacy-focused: zero telemetry, zero analytics, no ads, and FOSS (GPL-3.0).
